programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Fentanilo la nueva apuesta del narco

programme.title: Wonders of New Zealand
programme.desc: Wonders of New Zealand: South Island is a dynamic 4K UHD ambient nature film which showcases the beauty of New Zealand's South Island with ambient real-life nature sounds. For 1 hour you'll be transported from one amazing location to the next, - from the dazzling, other-worldly exotic landscapes of places like Milford Sound /Fiordland National Park, to the world's bluest lake Pukaki, the famous Tree at Lake Wanaka, and many places in between. Feel your worries fade away as you are immersed in the sights & sounds of more than 60 different stunning and alive 4K UHD nature scenes paired to soothing music for total relaxation.

programme.desc: This 1 hour ambient nature film contains awe-inspiring scenes from over 100 different exotic & iconic, natural destinations around the world. A seamless, graciously flowing mix of several Nature Relaxation shorter length productions, this video is designed to keep you in a state of complete relaxation from start to finish - transitioning you from golden sunsets to snowy mountaintops; from hidden canyon waterfalls to tropical islands so pure you've likely never seen anything like it!

programme.title: Mountains of Majesty
programme.desc: Let the wondrous sights and sounds of the Rocky Mountains fill your soul with peace and inspiration in this ultra-relaxing, full one hour long visual tour of one of Nature's most glorious places. Enjoy raging waterfalls, crystal clear mountain lakes, snowy mountain-tops, abundant wildlife, colorful wildflowers, and much more as you lose your worries in place of wonders. With just nature sounds.

programme.title: Above the Fiji Islands II 1

At the end of the film, there is a beautiful real-time sunset so viewers can enjoy watching the sun as it sinks into the sea...

programme.title: Croatia
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau visits the amazing landscape of Croatia, which has some of the worlds' most amazing waterfalls and caves. At the Plitvice Lakes National Park, Philippe explores the ever changing lakes systems due to naturally forming dams. Philippe also discovers some large caves and sees how stalactites and stalagmites are formed. Then it's onto the island of Brac, which is famous for their limestone quarries. We visit a stone masonry school where students turn white limestone into beautiful works of art.

programme.title: Future Energy
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau looks at renewable sources of energy that can replace our reliance on fossil fuels and consequently, help clean up our atmosphere. Solar panels, wind turbines and hydro-power are clean forms of energy that are being developed and deployed throughout the world. There's also an environment-friendly replacement for gasoline in the form of algae biofuel. Philippe shares all the exciting new developments in this area and gives hope for a healthier future of our planet.

programme.title: Croatia
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau visits the amazing landscape of Croatia, which has some of the worlds' most amazing waterfalls and caves. At the Plitvice Lakes National Park, Philippe explores the ever changing lakes systems due to naturally forming dams. Philippe also discovers some large caves and sees how stalactites and stalagmites are formed. Then it's onto the island of Brac, which is famous for their limestone quarries. We visit a stone masonry school where students turn white limestone into beautiful works of art.

programme.title: Future Energy
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau looks at renewable sources of energy that can replace our reliance on fossil fuels and consequently, help clean up our atmosphere. Solar panels, wind turbines and hydro-power are clean forms of energy that are being developed and deployed throughout the world. There's also an environment-friendly replacement for gasoline in the form of algae biofuel. Philippe shares all the exciting new developments in this area and gives hope for a healthier future of our planet.

programme.title: Croatia
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau visits the amazing landscape of Croatia, which has some of the worlds' most amazing waterfalls and caves. At the Plitvice Lakes National Park, Philippe explores the ever changing lakes systems due to naturally forming dams. Philippe also discovers some large caves and sees how stalactites and stalagmites are formed. Then it's onto the island of Brac, which is famous for their limestone quarries. We visit a stone masonry school where students turn white limestone into beautiful works of art.

programme.title: Future Energy
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau looks at renewable sources of energy that can replace our reliance on fossil fuels and consequently, help clean up our atmosphere. Solar panels, wind turbines and hydro-power are clean forms of energy that are being developed and deployed throughout the world. There's also an environment-friendly replacement for gasoline in the form of algae biofuel. Philippe shares all the exciting new developments in this area and gives hope for a healthier future of our planet.

This annual father-son trip is built on early mornings, shared stories, and moments that stick with you long after the season ends. It’s the memories made over the years that keep calling them back—and this year will be no different.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: In 2010, Amberly Snyder’s life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you’d see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly’s story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: When a national day of mourning in London for a fallen leader turns into a horrific terrorist attack, the clock begins ticking for Mike Banning, a seasoned Secret Service agent, and President Asher. What starts as a solemn funeral quickly devolves into chaos as heavily armed insurgents storm the event, resulting in unprecedented violence across the city. Banning, determined to save the President, navigates through a landscape filled with misinformation and danger, uncovering a deeper conspiracy led by the vengeful arms dealer Aamir Barkawi, whose ties to global terrorism threaten more than just the safety of those physically present. With the breakdown of communication channels and infiltration of key security measures, the protagonist must rely on quick thinking and adrenaline-fueled action to outsmart the enemy. The lives of countless civilians are at stake as Banning engages in a tense battle against time, aiming not only to rescue the President but also to dismantle a profoundly dangerous network designed to sow chaos and destruction worldwide. As the crisis unfolds, it becomes more than just a fight for survival; it's a terrifying examination of the fragility of peace and the price of freedom in a convoluted world.

programme.title: Noroi: The Curse
programme.desc: Noroi: The Curse follows investigative reporter Masafumi Kobayashi as he delves into a series of strange and unsettling paranormal events. Using a pseudo-documentary format, the film documents his investigation into mysterious occurrences linked to an ancient folkloric demon. As Kobayashi uncovers horrifying connections, he is drawn deeper into a terrifying web of supernatural forces, experiencing events that defy logic and push him—and the audience—toward a chilling confrontation with evil beyond imagination.

programme.title: The White Reindeer
programme.desc: The debut feature film by Finnish documentarian Erik Blomberg, this eerie and spectacularly filmed horror experience (Mondo Digital) remains a pioneering shocker of shamanism, vampirism and female sexuality: Unknowingly born a witch, a frustrated young Lapland wife (co-writer Mirjami Kuosmanen) shapeshifts into a bloodthirsty white reindeer with an insatiable appetite for the local herdsmen.

programme.title: Killers from Space
programme.desc: After suffering a traumatic plane crash, an atomic scientist named Doug Martin (Peter Graves) is convinced he has been abducted by aliens.Not only that, but he believes the aliens are out to conquer Earth! It's a nuclear nightmare! Yes, it is one of those movies where the aliens have bulging eyes, allegedly made from the bottoms of egg cartons.This is also one of the first films where abductees discuss being probed by their alien captors. Also starring James Seay, Steve Pendleton, Frank Gerstle, and Barbara Bestar. Directed by W. Lee Wilder.
